change: Apache Commons Compress — Agree on whether a TAR entry is a file or a directory
deployment: Both complete production JARs and original runtime graph. The landed distribution fixture is copied from the pinned fix tree and checked by hash.
assumptions: The unmodified upstream TAR is enumerated in stream order twice. Both passes hash each name, header type, two predicates, length and payload digest.

questions.observer: Report file, directory and overlap counts, byte total, and an ordered digest covering every entry on both readbacks.
questions.basis: Python tarfile independently reads all 481 headers and payloads. The directory named orjson-3.7.8/include has type 5 and no final slash.

questions.observer: Read a directory named dir/ and a regular file with bytes 00 ff, checking both flags and the full payload twice.
questions.basis: Both the slash and the explicit directory header identify dir/ on both releases.
